test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 4 days then, B alone can do 21-times of the same work in ______________(days)
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A and B together = 2 days

Time taken by A alone = 4 days

Find the time taken by B alone to do 21 times the same work.

**Formula used:**

Work done per day = (Total Work)/(Time Taken)

**Calculation:**

LCM of 2 and 4 = 4 (Assuming total work = 4 units)

Efficiency of A alone = 4 / 4 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of (A + B) together = 4 / 2 = 2 units/day

Efficiency of B alone:

⇒ (A + B) - A = 2 - 1 = 1 unit/day

Time taken by B alone to complete 1 work:

⇒ 4 / 1 = 4 days

Time taken by B alone to complete 21 times the work:

⇒ 4 × 21 = 84 days

**∴ B alone can do 21 times the same work in 84 days.**
